summary: community.aws waf_condition, waf_info, waf_rule and waf_web_acl are deprecated because AWS retired WAF Classic; use WAFv2, with removal in 12.0.0.
questions: Why are the WAF modules in community.aws deprecated?
What should I use instead of WAF Classic modules?

answer_card.title: WAF Classic modules deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `waf_condition`, `waf_info`, `waf_rule` and `waf_web_acl` in community.aws are deprecated because Amazon **retired WAF Classic**. Use the **AWS WAF (WAFv2)** service and modules instead. These modules are removed in version 12.0.0.
